justification: The agent correctly identifies the product details, both suppliers (SUP-001 at 280 THB and SUP-004 at 270 THB), and current inventory of 8 units. However, it completely misses the critical fact that PO-008 (150 units from SUP-001) is already in transit with expected delivery 2026-02-18. The agent explicitly states 'No inbound supply in 10+ weeks' and recommends placing a new PO — both conclusions are wrong given PO-008 exists. This fundamentally changes the supply chain diagnosis.

Two suppliers: SUP-001 at 280 THB (SP-001) and SUP-004 at 270 THB (SP-009)
Current inventory: 8 units available, below reorder point of 20
Multiple historical POs and customer orders cited
Active demand exceeds available stock (ORD-007 needs 50 units)
Reorder point of 20 too low given demand spikes
facts_missing: PO-008 (150 units from SUP-001) is in transit, expected 2026-02-18 — this is a critical inbound supply that resolves the stockout
